name: Desk
summary: A quiet, filmic desk sitcom: the lead at a desk at night, the agents standing on the desk, a big window of city lights behind.

shotTypes.lead: the lead, three-quarter MCU from the agents' side, pushes in 10%
shotTypes.front: the lead frontal MCU, eyes in the lens, for sincere lines and silent beats
shotTypes.cu: an agent close at desk height, the lead soft behind, pulls out 12%
shotTypes.two: two agents (or an agent and the lead) in one frame
shotTypes.wide: the whole desk from the front, near deep focus
shotTypes.high: a high wide over the desk
shotTypes.end: the closing wide that pulls back about 20% to reveal the room
shotTypes.board: the classroom's whiteboard filling the frame (classroom only)

spec.Set: One real-size desk at night: lamp, laptop, mug, chair; a big window of city lights behind
spec.Screen: Nothing to read: the laptop only glows
spec.Render look: Low poly, teal and orange, matte, faint bloom, soft shadows
spec.Lens and focus: Long lenses (21 to 22 degrees), very shallow focus: city lights become big soft discs
spec.Camera motion: One slow dolly per shot: push in on the lead, pull out on the agents
spec.Cutting: About 20 shots per 45 s; cut 0.2 s before each line
spec.Captions: Arial Bold 47 px in a 50% black rounded box, centred 285 px from the top
spec.Sound: Voices and room tone only (-42 dBFS); no music, no effects
spec.Best for: Everyday-AI jokes, daily posting; cheaper per episode (one set, fewer shots)

night-city.name: Night city
night-city.summary: The desk at night: a warm desk lamp, a big window of city lights the long lens turns into soft discs.

dusk.name: Dusk
dusk.summary: Sundown: a lavender sky turning pink, then peach at the horizon, dark towers with the first lit windows, the lamp already on.

rain.name: Rain
rain.summary: A grey evening: rain streaking past the window and beading on the glass, cool towers, the lamp the only warm thing in the room.

morning.name: Morning
morning.summary: Daylight: a pale blue sky, soft blue-grey towers, the sun behind the desk, the lamp off.

living-room.name: Living room
living-room.summary: An evening on the sofa: the lead sits back on a teal sofa, the agents stand on the coffee table, a floor lamp warms the room, the city at blue hour through the window.

classroom.name: Classroom
classroom.summary: An after-hours lesson: a whiteboard writes itself as the agent explains from a stack of books with a pointer, the lead at a school desk, a bookshelf, a window at blue hour.

diner.name: Diner
diner.summary: A booth at night: a red vinyl booth, a cream table with a chrome edge, pendant lamps, a night street with neon signs through the window, a checked floor.

campfire.name: Campfire
campfire.summary: A camp in the mountains at dusk: the lead on a log, the agents on a plank camp table, a fire low in front that lights everyone warm, a tent and a lantern behind, violet mountains and the first stars.

rooftop.name: Rooftop
rooftop.summary: A city rooftop at golden hour: a wooden bench and table, string lights between two poles, a parapet and a water tower, the skyline against a gold-to-blue sky with the sun low.
